name: Lich Lord Ilron

facts.text: Level 79, 100,000 health. Raises four images of himself (level 70) that fight linked with him; tether 2,000.
Existing bot chat says most Caer Sidi stories end at him.

story:
Ilron was a priest once, of which god nobody remembers, and he came to Caer Sidi because he would not stay dead and would not say why. When the gaol rose he was among the first to claim a gallery of his own. He studied the one art a prisoner has in plenty, which is waiting, and he learned to be in several places at once: four images of himself walk his gallery, each as solid as the next, and only one of them has aged a day since he was locked in. Most of the tales of Caer Sidi end at Ilron, because most raids spend their strength on the wrong Ilron.

Who he was. Ilron was a priest, of which god nobody now remembers, and he came to Caer Sidi because he would not stay dead and would not say why. The keepers kept him in the galleries, apart from the common prisoners, with the other priests and wizards who had found ways back. He spent the centuries learning the one art a prisoner has in plenty, which is waiting, and from waiting he learned how to be in several places at once.

The images. When the gaol rose he took a gallery of his own and filled it with himself. Four images of Ilron walk beside the true one when he is threatened, each as solid as the next and each casting its spells, and only one of the five has grown older in the gaol; the images are as he was when he came, and they hold still whoever stands close to them. A raid that spreads its strength across all five is a raid that dies in his gallery, and so most of the tales of Caer Sidi end at Ilron. He does not hate the living. He finds them predictable. He has a short leash on his gallery; draw him too far from it and he walks home, and his images go with him.
legend: Four images of Ilron come with him, and they are real enough to hurt. Do not spread your damage over all five: one group on each image to hold or kill it, and the raid on the true one. He walks home if you drag him more than about two thousand units, so fight him in his gallery. This is where most Caer Sidi raids stopped in 2003; take your time picking the right target. The real Ilron is the one that cons highest: he is level 79, the images are 70 with about ten thousand health each, and they mesmerize anyone standing close. Target him, not them; when he dies they go with him. The raid that spreads its damage over all five writes another story that ends at Ilron.

loremasterTopic.text: Most of the tales I know end at him. He shows you four of himself; only one is true. Find the one that matters.

bookPage: In the gallery Ilron showed us four of himself, and they moved as he moved and cast as he cast, and our wizards spent their fire on the wrong three. That is where the company I went up with the summer before had broken. This time Dame Ysolde waited until each figure stepped into the lamplight, and watched for the one whose face had aged. It took the length of three heartbeats. Then she called his name and every spell in the company went to the same place, and the other four stopped, and stood, and were nothing at all.
